Power Query architecture (all exercises applied):

• orders-2026-01/02/03 — raw Web-source queries per month, load disabled, each tagged with SourceFile for lineage.

• stg_OrdersCombined — appends the three raw queries into one staged query, load disabled.

• err_OrdersReview — a Reference of stg_OrdersCombined that isolates rows with a DataQualityIssue (missing/invalid OrderDate, non-positive Quantity/UnitPrice, missing ProductCode). Load disabled by default; enable temporarily in Desktop to review rejected rows.

• fn_CleanText — reusable, null-safe custom function (Text.Proper/Trim/Clean) applied to CustomerName and SalesChannel.

• FactOrders — final load query: filters out data-quality issues, applies explicit types, filters to the RangeStart/RangeEnd window (incremental-refresh ready), cleans text, and removes the validation column. This is the only query with load enabled from this chain.

• product-category-map — Web-source reference table using fn_CleanText on ProductName/Category/Subcategory, built from RawDataBaseUrl.

• Parameters: RawDataBaseUrl (Text), RangeStart/RangeEnd (DateTime), SourceFolderPath (Text, optional/blank), EnvironmentName (Text, Dev/Test/Prod placeholder).

Query folding and Service-side incremental refresh policy are Verify for Gov / source-dependent — see the Lab 03 README Gov notes.
